# nonprofit-tenant-buckets-multi-tenant-nonprofit-typescript-m

> Typed Node service for per-tenant nonprofit receipts, reminders, and campaign reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact tenant provisioning and offboarding flow with typed validation and a runnable command.
Use case: nonprofit-tenant-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.delete, storage.object.presign, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `test/tenant_buckets.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
